title: CLEO rejected an opcode
hint: An INI or plugin opcode may be missing its CLEO 2 plugin. See Memory.md, INI Plugin.

title: CLEO script or plugin failed to load
hint: Check the .cm header, the CLEO folder for stale duplicates, and install.ts output.

ignore: host version is unknown|unknown command IMGUI_
title: CLEO Redux warning
ModLoader problem
hint: Compare against modloader-guidance: package folder layout, manifest IDE/IPL/COLFILE lines, priorities.

title: Debug value is negative (a blip or entity handle of -1)
hint: A Blip.Add* command returns -1 when the blip pool is full.

title: Char.RemoveElegantly ran every frame
hint: Guard the removal so it runs once per handle.

title: Game exited without CLEO's shutdown marker (likely a crash)
hint: Read the tail of scrlog.log for the last commands that ran before the exit.

title: SCRLog never wrote its footer (likely a crash)
hint: Read the tail of scrlog.log for the last commands that ran before the exit.
